title: Google Scholar Scraper
description: Search Google Scholar for paper titles, authors, publication details, citations, and available resources. Batch research queries to build literature lists or monitor academic topics.

batch.title: Research queries
batch.description: Academic search phrases. Add one object per phrase.
batch.valueDescription: q used to run this search.

schema.description: Scholar search query. Optional when cites or cluster is supplied.
Two-letter interface language, optionally with a region. Defaults to en.
Zero-based result offset from 0 to 990. Defaults to 0.
Results per request from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.
0 for relevance, 1 for recent abstracts, or 2 for all recent additions.
Numeric publication ID for a cited-by search. May be combined with q.
Numeric publication ID for an all-versions search. Must be used alone.

organic_results.title: How Search Interfaces Shape Literature Reviews
organic_results.snippet: This study compares citation discovery and screening workflows across digital research libraries.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Google Scholar for papers, publication details, result links, and resources. Build literature review datasets and track academic research by topic.
storeCopy.intro: Collect ranked Scholar results for research topics. Rows include paper titles, result IDs, publication summaries, snippets, links, and available resources.
useCases: Researchers can collect paper details and publisher links by topic.
Librarians can build reading lists from ranked Google Scholar results.
Research teams can monitor publication coverage for recurring queries.
howToUse: Add one research phrase per item in `queries`.
Set `maxPages` to bound collection and `maxResults` to cap saved papers.
Review paper titles, publication details, links, and resources.

faqs.question: Does the Actor download full papers?
faqs.answer: No. It returns result metadata and resource links exposed in search results; publisher access rules still apply.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Position of the paper in Google Scholar results, starting at 1.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Paper title displayed by Google Scholar.

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: Google Scholar identifier associated with the paper record.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Google Scholar or publisher URL for the paper.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: Short paper excerpt or matching text shown in Scholar results.

fields.name: publication_info
fields.description: Publication venue, authors, and year displayed with the paper.

fields.name: resources
fields.description: Publisher and document links associated with the paper.

fields.name: input_q
fields.description: Research phrase submitted to Google Scholar for this result set.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this paper record was collected.
